name: Shutterstock, Inc.
blurb: Shutterstock, Inc. is a global creative platform that connects brands and businesses to high-quality content, including photographs, vectors, illustrations, and video footage. The company also offers data and AI solutions, serving customers in North America, Europe, and internationally. With a market cap of approximately $606 million and annual revenue of $946 million, Shutterstock competes in the digital content licensing space.
recent: Shutterstock reported first quarter 2026 financial results on April 28, 2026. The stock has traded in a 52-week range of $14.36 to $29.50, with a recent price around $16.49. Analysts have a buy rating and a price target of $25.00, implying over 50% upside.
